     When you pay by check, you authorize FPL to process your payment electronically or as a draft. If your payment is processed electronically,
     your checking account may be debited on the same day we receive the check and your check will not be returned with your checking account
     statement. If paying your bill in person and in cash, your payment may, consistent with Florida law, be rounded to the nearest five-cent (5¢)
     increment if one-cent coins are no longer in production. FPL does not agree to any restrictions, conditions or endorsements placed on any bill
     statement or payments such as check, money order or other forms of payment. We will process the payment as if these restrictions or conditions
     do not exist.
